name: full-game-economy-boundaries
description: Exercise authoritative negative, exact-cost, repeat, cooldown, claim, and rebirth boundaries used by the complete-game acceptance pass.

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local c=game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild('PunchWallAutomation',5)
assert(c,'missing automation')
c:Invoke('Reset')
c:Invoke('SetStats',{Coins=179,Depth=1,OwnedFistsJSON='["Starter Glove"]',EquippedFist='Starter Glove',FistMultiplier=1})
local low=c:Invoke('BuyFist','Boxing Glove')
assert(low.ok==false and low.reason=='not_enough_coins' and low.Coins==179,'fist cost-1 mutated state')
c:Invoke('SetStats',{Coins=180})
local exact=c:Invoke('BuyFist','Boxing Glove')
assert(exact.ok==true and exact.Coins==0 and exact.EquippedFist=='Boxing Glove','exact fist purchase failed')
local repeatBuy=c:Invoke('BuyFist','Boxing Glove')
assert(repeatBuy.ok==true and repeatBuy.outcome=='equipped' and repeatBuy.Coins==0,'owned fist repeat charged or failed')
local invalidEquip=c:Invoke('EquipFist','Celestial Titan Fist')
assert(invalidEquip.ok==false and invalidEquip.reason=='not_owned' and invalidEquip.Coins==0,'not-owned fist equip mutated state')
return H:JSONEncode({costMinusOne=low.reason,exactCoins=exact.Coins,repeatOutcome=repeatBuy.outcome,notOwned=invalidEquip.reason,equipped=repeatBuy.EquippedFist})

steps.label: verify fist purchase and equip boundaries

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local config=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig)
local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation
local first=config.HonorItems[1]
assert(first,'missing honor catalog')
c:Invoke('Reset')
c:Invoke('SetStats',{Honor=first.cost-1,OwnedHonorItemsJSON='[]',EquippedHonorItem='None',HonorPowerBonus=0})
local low=c:Invoke('BuyHonorItem',first.name)
assert(low.ok==false and low.reason=='not_enough_honor' and low.Honor==first.cost-1,'honor cost-1 mutated state')
c:Invoke('SetStats',{Honor=first.cost})
local exact=c:Invoke('BuyHonorItem',first.name)
assert(exact.ok==true and exact.Honor==0 and exact.EquippedHonorItem==first.name,'exact honor purchase failed')
local repeatBuy=c:Invoke('BuyHonorItem',first.name)
assert(repeatBuy.ok==true and repeatBuy.Honor==0 and repeatBuy.EquippedHonorItem==first.name,'owned honor repeat charged or failed')
c:Invoke('SetStats',{Honor=100000})
local count=1
for index=2,#config.HonorItems do local r=c:Invoke('BuyHonorItem',config.HonorItems[index].name) assert(r.ok==true,'honor catalog purchase failed at '..index) count+=1 end
local final=c:Invoke('Snapshot')
local owned=H:JSONDecode(final.OwnedHonorItemsJSON)
assert(#owned==#config.HonorItems,'honor ownership catalog incomplete')
return H:JSONEncode({low=low.reason,exact=exact.ok,repeatHonor=repeatBuy.Honor,catalog=count,owned=#owned,equipped=final.EquippedHonorItem})

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local actionRemote=RS.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest
local feedbackRemote=RS.PunchWallEvents.Feedback
local function snapshot()
 return {lastSpinAt=p.RPGStats.LastSpinAt.Value,credits=p.RPGStats.SpinCredits.Value,coins=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value,power=p.leaderstats.Power.Value,honor=p.leaderstats.Honor.Value,pets=p.RPGStats.PetInventoryJSON.Value}
end
local replicationDeadline=os.clock()+3
local baseline=snapshot()
while not (baseline.credits==0 and baseline.coins==37 and baseline.power==43 and baseline.honor==11 and baseline.pets=='[]') and os.clock()<replicationDeadline do
 task.wait(.05)
 baseline=snapshot()
end
local baselineReady=baseline.credits==0 and baseline.coins==37 and baseline.power==43 and baseline.honor==11 and baseline.pets=='[]'
assert(baselineReady,'cooldown Spin baseline replication failed: '..H:JSONEncode(baseline))
local events={}
local feedbackBefore=gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0
local toastSequenceBefore=gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0
local rewardSequenceBefore=gui.RewardPops:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0
local connection
local result
local ok,err=xpcall(function()
 connection=feedbackRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
  if typeof(payload)=='table' then
   table.insert(events,{type=tostring(payload.type or ''),target=tostring(payload.target or ''),message=tostring(payload.message or ''),kind=tostring(payload.kind or ''),amount=tonumber(payload.amount) or 0})
  end
 end)
 actionRemote:FireServer({action='Spin'})
 local eventDeadline=os.clock()+2
 while #events==0 and os.clock()<eventDeadline do task.wait(.03) end
 local presentationDeadline=os.clock()+.5
 while os.clock()<presentationDeadline and ((gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0)<feedbackBefore+1 or (gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0)<toastSequenceBefore+1) do task.wait(.02) end
 local duplicateWindowDeadline=os.clock()+.15
 while os.clock()<duplicateWindowDeadline do task.wait(.02) end
 local after=snapshot()
 local event=events[1]
 local feedbackDelta=(gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0)-feedbackBefore
 local toastSequenceDelta=(gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0)-toastSequenceBefore
 local rewardSequenceDelta=(gui.RewardPops:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0)-rewardSequenceBefore
 local bounded=gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('PresentationMode')=='BoundedVisibleQueueV1' and gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('MaxVisibleItems')==3 and (gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('VisibleItemCount') or 0)<=3
 local unchanged=after.lastSpinAt==baseline.lastSpinAt and after.credits==baseline.credits and after.coins==baseline.coins and after.power==baseline.power and after.honor==baseline.honor and after.pets==baseline.pets
 local failures={}
 local function expect(condition,name) if not condition then table.insert(failures,name) end end
 expect(#events==1,'event_count')
 expect(event and event.type=='Fail','event_type')
 expect(event and event.target=='Spin','event_target')
 expect(unchanged,'authority_mutation')
 expect(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType')=='Fail','terminal_type')
 expect(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget')=='Spin','terminal_target')
 expect(feedbackDelta==1,'feedback_delta')
 expect(toastSequenceDelta==1,'toast_sequence_delta')
 expect(rewardSequenceDelta==0,'reward_sequence_leak')
 expect(bounded,'toast_not_bounded')
 result={valid=#failures==0,failures=failures,eventCount=#events,type=event and event.type or '',target=event and event.target or '',message=event and event.message or '',unchanged=unchanged,feedbackDelta=feedbackDelta,terminalType=gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType'),terminalTarget=gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget'),toastSequenceDelta=toastSequenceDelta,rewardSequenceDelta=rewardSequenceDelta,bounded=bounded,lastSpinAt=after.lastSpinAt,credits=after.credits,coins=after.coins,power=after.power,honor=after.honor,pets=after.pets}
end,debug.traceback)
if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
assert(ok,'cooldown Spin probe crashed: '..tostring(err))
assert(result.valid,'cooldown Spin client contract failed: '..H:JSONEncode(result))
return H:JSONEncode(result)

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local actionRemote=RS.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest
local feedbackRemote=RS.PunchWallEvents.Feedback
local function snapshot()
 return {lastSpinAt=p.RPGStats.LastSpinAt.Value,credits=p.RPGStats.SpinCredits.Value,coins=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value,power=p.leaderstats.Power.Value,honor=p.leaderstats.Honor.Value,pets=p.RPGStats.PetInventoryJSON.Value}
end
local replicationDeadline=os.clock()+3
local baseline=snapshot()
while not (baseline.credits==1 and baseline.coins==0 and baseline.power==15 and baseline.honor==0 and baseline.pets=='[]') and os.clock()<replicationDeadline do
 task.wait(.05)
 baseline=snapshot()
end
local baselineReady=baseline.credits==1 and baseline.coins==0 and baseline.power==15 and baseline.honor==0 and baseline.pets=='[]'
assert(baselineReady,'credit Spin baseline replication failed: '..H:JSONEncode(baseline))
local events={}
local feedbackBefore=gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0
local toastSequenceBefore=gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0
local rewardSequenceBefore=gui.RewardPops:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0
local connection
local result
local ok,err=xpcall(function()
 connection=feedbackRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
  if typeof(payload)=='table' then
   table.insert(events,{type=tostring(payload.type or ''),target=tostring(payload.target or ''),kind=tostring(payload.kind or ''),amount=tonumber(payload.amount) or 0,reward=tostring(payload.reward or '')})
  end
 end)
 actionRemote:FireServer({action='Spin'})
 local eventDeadline=os.clock()+2
 while #events==0 and os.clock()<eventDeadline do task.wait(.03) end
 local function exactApplied(event,after)
  if not event or event.amount<=0 then return false,'' end
  if event.kind=='Coins' then return after.credits==0 and after.coins==baseline.coins+event.amount and after.power==baseline.power and after.honor==baseline.honor and after.pets==baseline.pets,'Coins' end
  if event.kind=='Power' then return after.credits==0 and after.power==baseline.power+event.amount and after.coins==baseline.coins and after.honor==baseline.honor and after.pets==baseline.pets,'Power' end
  if event.kind=='Honor' then return after.credits==0 and after.honor==baseline.honor+event.amount and after.coins==baseline.coins and after.power==baseline.power and after.pets==baseline.pets,'Honor' end
  if event.kind=='BonusSpin' then return after.credits==1 and after.coins==baseline.coins and after.power==baseline.power and after.honor==baseline.honor and after.pets==baseline.pets,'BonusSpin' end
  return false,''
 end
 local after=snapshot()
 local event=events[1]
 local applied,authorityPath=exactApplied(event,after)
 local mutationDeadline=os.clock()+1
 while event and not applied and os.clock()<mutationDeadline do task.wait(.03) after=snapshot() applied,authorityPath=exactApplied(event,after) end
 local presentationDeadline=os.clock()+.5
 while os.clock()<presentationDeadline and ((gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0)<feedbackBefore+1 or (gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0)<toastSequenceBefore+1) do task.wait(.02) end
 local duplicateWindowDeadline=os.clock()+.15
 while os.clock()<duplicateWindowDeadline do task.wait(.02) end
 local feedbackDelta=(gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0)-feedbackBefore
 local toastSequenceDelta=(gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0)-toastSequenceBefore
 local rewardSequenceDelta=(gui.RewardPops:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0)-rewardSequenceBefore
 local bounded=gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('PresentationMode')=='BoundedVisibleQueueV1' and gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('MaxVisibleItems')==3 and (gui.Toasts:GetAttribute('VisibleItemCount') or 0)<=3
 local failures={}
 local function expect(condition,name) if not condition then table.insert(failures,name) end end
 expect(#events==1,'event_count')
 expect(event and event.type=='SpinResult','event_type')
 expect(event and event.target~='','event_target')
 expect(event and event.reward~='','event_reward')
 expect(event and event.amount>0,'event_amount')
 expect(applied,'authority_mutation')
 expect(after.lastSpinAt==baseline.lastSpinAt,'cooldown_timestamp_changed')
 expect(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType')=='SpinResult','terminal_type')
 expect(event and gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget')==event.target,'terminal_target')
 expect(feedbackDelta==1,'feedback_delta')
 expect(toastSequenceDelta==1,'toast_sequence_delta')
 expect(rewardSequenceDelta==0,'reward_sequence_leak')
 expect(bounded,'toast_not_bounded')
 result={valid=#failures==0,failures=failures,eventCount=#events,type=event and event.type or '',target=event and event.target or '',reward=event and event.reward or '',kind=event and event.kind or '',amount=event and event.amount or 0,applied=applied,authorityPath=authorityPath,lastSpinUnchanged=after.lastSpinAt==baseline.lastSpinAt,feedbackDelta=feedbackDelta,terminalType=gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType'),terminalTarget=gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget'),toastSequenceDelta=toastSequenceDelta,rewardSequenceDelta=rewardSequenceDelta,bounded=bounded,credits=after.credits,coins=after.coins,power=after.power,honor=after.honor,pets=after.pets}
end,debug.traceback)
if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
assert(ok,'credit Spin probe crashed: '..tostring(err))
assert(result.valid,'credit Spin client contract failed: '..H:JSONEncode(result))
return H:JSONEncode(result)

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]
local result={lastSpinAt=p.RPGStats.LastSpinAt.Value,baselineLastSpinAt=p:GetAttribute('EconomyCreditBaselineLastSpinAt'),credits=p.RPGStats.SpinCredits.Value,coins=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value,power=p.leaderstats.Power.Value,honor=p.leaderstats.Honor.Value,pets=p.RPGStats.PetInventoryJSON.Value}
local bonus=result.credits==1 and result.coins==0 and result.power==15 and result.honor==0 and result.pets=='[]'
local coins=result.credits==0 and result.coins>0 and result.power==15 and result.honor==0 and result.pets=='[]'
local power=result.credits==0 and result.coins==0 and result.power>15 and result.honor==0 and result.pets=='[]'
local honor=result.credits==0 and result.coins==0 and result.power==15 and result.honor>0 and result.pets=='[]'
local pathCount=(bonus and 1 or 0)+(coins and 1 or 0)+(power and 1 or 0)+(honor and 1 or 0)
result.authorityPath=bonus and 'BonusSpin' or coins and 'Coins' or power and 'Power' or honor and 'Honor' or ''
result.lastSpinUnchanged=result.lastSpinAt==result.baselineLastSpinAt
result.creditBounded=result.credits>=0 and result.credits<=1
result.rewardApplied=pathCount==1
assert(result.lastSpinUnchanged and result.creditBounded and result.rewardApplied,'real credit Spin authority contract failed: '..H:JSONEncode(result))
return H:JSONEncode(result)
